notes.title: Short Digital Manga Release Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Manga "Welcome to the Karoshi Club" Release![/h1]
Hooray! The manga "Welcome to the Karoshi Club" is now available for free download!

The manga author is Valerie Yogay, an old-school mangaka.
This style is something you are going to absolutely love!
We want to thank everyone who contributed to its development!

We are excited to share some inside information about Kenji Haishima, the Keneō Industry, and the afterlife world of Yomi.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/abc38d3c282e2874ecc9d065f5ba60e99182cc11.png[/img]

[h1]How to read and access manga?[/h1]

1. Add the DLC to your library and download the minor update.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2722510/Welcome_to_the_Karoshi_Club_Manga/

2. Right-click on the game Welcome to the Karoshi Club in your library and click "[i]Properties[/i]":

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/2dc001920f3f6f1ae1718c21e1d022a9eae5bc24.png[/img]

3. In the next window, select "[i]Installed Files[/i]" and next to the section "[i]Size of Installation[/i]," click on the "[i]Browse[/i]" button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/da25b83ebe14edfc732067c04c89348da443fac6.png[/img]

4. Click on the [b]KaroshiManga[/b] folder, and the PDF manga file will be there!

[i](The manga is implemented through the functionality of additional files for the game, for example, as an game art book)[/i]

[h1]When can we expect translations in other languages?[/h1]

The manga is only available in English, but we plan to add Russian and Japanese translations as additional PDF files this month.



We hope you enjoy this brief explanation of Yomi's afterlife features.
Looking forward to seeing you for the Karoshi Club announcement!

Yours, Kamishibai Teams.

notes.title: Welcome to the Update 1.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to the Update 1.2[/h1]

We are delighted to announce that update 1.2, which includes several new wishes mentioned in community game reviews, is launching today.

We appreciate all the feedback we received from you and are grateful for your valuable comments and suggestions. Your continuous support and feedback have helped us improve our project, and we would like to express our gratitude for your contribution.

Thank you for being with us on this journey to improve our free prologue [i]Welcome to the Karoshi Club[/i].

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Add Volume Settings in the Main menu:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/d4420d3911a807d11ac3f7b43b34bcc887cf70bd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/c974b90a9b480d68453446fd90e17879ac38949c.png[/img]
[i]Sound settings are saved when switching scenes, and volume adjustments can be made in the main menu.[/i]

[list]
[*] Rewind Functional:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/d73a44b19c39076d20990406dfadfe7840da1623.png[/img]
[i]After completing the game for the first time, when you start playing it again, and a new act is announced, you will notice a rewind button on the upper right corner of the screen. This button will take you directly to the question in the act, making playtime in the game easier.[/i]
[list]

[*] Add Italian Language Support (Many thanks to Francesco Papeo):
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/897e3d8192b992f8a98016f5286e130e33918572.png[/img]
[i]We are thrilled when people offer to help translate our game into other languages. It warms our hearts, and we are highly grateful for their support. We are excited to announce that we now have Italian language support in the game thanks to the talented specialist from Italy, Francesco Papeo! The entire team is grateful for your contribution and would like to express our gratitude.[/i]

[h1]Karoshi Japanese LQA Help[/h1]
We have received comments that the Japanese translation of our project, [i]Welcome to the Karoshi Club[/i], may contain some errors in understanding. If someone in our community is a specialist in Japanese and can help us with Language Quality Assurance (LQA), [url=https://discord.com/invite/mNmJ7auHVc]we kindly request you to respond on our Discord channel[/url]. 

In return for your assistance, we would be delighted to include your name in the credits for [i]Welcome to the Karoshi Club[/i].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/2bb28050fa743c9bc48bcab25473b52ff876b68e.png[/img]

[h1]Manga "Welcome to the Karoshi Club" release window[/h1]
We apologize for the delay in releasing the promised manga and Update 1.2. We have decided to make some necessary improvements before its release.

We are working on a short manga that will connect the story of [i]Welcome to the Karoshi Club[/i] with the [i]Karoshi Club[/i]. We anticipate that it will be released in late May or early June. We are trying to complete it by then, and we hope you will enjoy getting to know [i]Kumi Yamane[/i].

Make sure to add the manga to your wishlist for release updates.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2722510/Welcome_to_the_Karoshi_Club_Manga/

[h1]Karoshi Community Spotlight - April[/h1]
[i]If you're interested in showcasing your creativity in the Karoshi Club universe, we'd love to feature you in our future Community Spotlights, particularly for the Letsplay game and fan art! Please use our Community Hub in Steam.[/i]

[b]Walkthroughs[/b]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2113998188]Indie Horror Night![/url] by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/grimmivt]grimmiVT[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/8e772ba6918a50aec6f063ff9bc2944815688562.png[/img]
[It turned out great! We're thrilled to be on your Twitch stream.]
/ᐠ - ⩊ -マ₊˚⊹♡₊ ⊹


ONE HECK OF A JOB INTERVIEW!!! | Welcome to Karoshi Club by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@GameZane66]Game Zane[/url]
[previewyoutube=MIfC_14w2Rk;full][/previewyoutube]
[It was a pleasure being featured on your video channel!]
˶^•ﻌ•^˵

[h1]Let's say goodbye for now and greet each other again in the future[/h1]

Well, we can finally close the chapter on [i]Welcome to the Karoshi Club[/i] and fully immerse ourselves in our new projects, [i]Karoshi Club[/i] and [i]Project: Celestine[/i]. 

This will be the last major update for our free prologue, and we will only have small updates from now on. We want to express our gratitude for your support and feedback.

Thank you to all those who have been with us from the beginning until now. You guys are the best!

We will announce [i]Karoshi Club[/i] by releasing the manga [i]Welcome to the Karoshi Club[/i].

We are preparing something unfamiliar and unusual, so stay tuned!

Yours, Kamishibai team.
( ⓛ ﻌ ⓛ )

notes.title: Welcome to the Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Release Update 1.1[/h1]
Get ready for a new Karoshi Club update!

[b]Release Notes Update 1.1:[/b]
[list]
[*] Text: Some English phrases have been simplified, but the text editors have not yet completed the editing process. The final edits will be included in the next update
[*] Gameplay: New images have been added to the neutral and bad endings
[*] Settings: Added music volume slider
[*] Settings: Added sound volume slider
[*] Settings: Added font slider from original to large
[*] Minor changes and fixes
[/list]

[h1]Localization Pack #1[/h1]
We are happy to announce the release of the first localization pack—many thanks to everyone who assisted us in implementing it, including translators and LQA experts.

[list]
[*]Add Support Japanese Language Pack
[*]Add Support Russian Language Pack
[/list]

If you notice any issues with the localization, please don't hesitate to report it to us on our Discord server. We have created a separate topic and questionnaire specifically for this purpose. We would appreciate it if you could take the time to help us improve the localization. Thank you!

[h1]Future Plans[/h1]
Update 1.2 plans:
[list]
[*] Text: The English text has been updated based on the edits made by the editors
[*] Gameplay: Rewind functional. We postponed this feature to the next update after failing to resolve this functionality bug quickly
[*] Localization: Add new language packs created by volunteer translators
[/list]

[h1]Team Feedback[/h1]
We are delighted that you have provided us with feedback and have been supporting us in general! We want to extend our special thanks to you for promoting Welcome to the Karoshi Club.

It inspires us and makes us even stronger.

We hope you enjoy the new updates for "Welcome to Club Karoshi". We'll see you in the new Community Info update with the manga release, "Welcome to the Karoshi Club," and future Version 1.2.

Your, Kamishibai Cat
